source.label: PAPA F-14 Tomcat tutorial with Bowen Kerins

strategy.summary: Use the upper orbit and upper flippers to spell T-O-M-C-A-T. Start multiball. Then cycle the right VUK to Fighter Jackpot.

steps.text: Use the launch to test the upper-orbit feed. Do not flip at the feed. Try a live catch on the lower flipper.
Prefer the upper T-O-M-C-A-T targets. Use the upper orbit and staged upper flippers. Use lower targets only for the last letter.
Check the lock and Release lamps, then complete T-O-M-C-A-T as the installed AD33 setting requires. Lock lit balls at the right VUK and shoot the lit Release shot to start multiball.
modeNotes: Lock qualification changes with the AD33 MLTIBAL MODE adjustment. Do not assume one universal first-two-lock and third-lock sequence.
Multiball locks: Lock balls at the right VUK. Shoot the lit Release shot after the third lock to start four-ball multiball.
Physical locks are shared. Depending on the chamber state, a lock can trigger an immediate replacement-ball serve. Stay at the flippers and regain control.

steps.text: During multiball, shoot the right VUK three times. The first two shots advance Landings. The third shot collects Fighter Jackpot.
modeNotes: Multiball: Each three-shot VUK cycle ends with Fighter Jackpot. Start another cycle while more than one ball remains.

steps.text: Use staged upper flippers to reduce side-to-side ball motion. Relight the left kickback at the Rescue target when safe.

fallback.title: Upper-orbit control loop
fallback.when: Use this route when the T-O-M-C-A-T targets or right VUK return badly.

steps.text: Shoot the upper orbit. Do not flip with the upper flippers. Catch the ball on a lower flipper.
Backhand the upper orbit when this copy allows it. Repeat only while the catch remains controlled.
Clip the edge of the Rescue target to relight the left kickback. Do not shoot its center.

alternatives.title: Numbered feature ladder
alternatives.when: Use this route when the orbit, spinner, and inlanes are safe but multiball qualification is not.

steps.text: Complete numbered features 1 through 6 through normal play. Use the spinner and Flyby awards for points.
Complete the needed lit top lanes to raise the bonus multiplier toward 8x.
Collect Yagov extra ball only when tournament settings enable it.
Follow the installed AD33 setting and lock lamps. Lock three balls, then shoot the lit Release shot for four-ball multiball.
Complete repeated three-shot right-VUK cycles before multiball ends.

techniques.name: Flipper staging
techniques.instruction: Use separate flipper-button pressure to keep one upper flipper down. Flip only with the upper flipper that has the shot.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: From a controlled lower flipper, test a backhand to the upper orbit. Use it only when the machine accepts the angle.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Do not flip at the upper-orbit return. Let the ball fall to a lower flipper and test a live catch.

techniques.name: Rescue edge clip
techniques.instruction: Clip the edge of the Rescue target to relight the kickback. Avoid a square hit to its center.

cautions.issue: A shared physical lock can trigger an immediate replacement-ball serve.
cautions.response: Stay at the flippers after every lock and regain control before returning to the upper-orbit route.

cautions.issue: A direct Rescue target hit can rebound down the middle.
cautions.response: Clip the target edge. Use the shot only when you need the left kickback.

cautions.issue: The Yagov kickout can fire the ball toward the flippers.
cautions.response: Watch the first kickout. Keep both flippers ready until you know the feed.

cautions.issue: The left outlane is the main drain risk on many copies.
cautions.response: Relight the left kickback with a Rescue edge clip. Do not use a direct Rescue shot.

cautions.issue: Four balls can stay in the upper playfield and leave the lower flippers unprepared.
cautions.response: Use staged upper flippers. Track balls that leave the upper playfield before you aim another shot.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Use the upper orbit and upper flippers to spell T-O-M-C-A-T.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Follow the installed AD33 setting and lock lamps.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Upper-orbit control loop: Use this route when the T-O-M-C-A-T targets or right VUK return badly.

quickInfo.name: ROM and settings
quickInfo.summary: The production ROM is L-1; adjustment AD33 changes multiball qualification, so follow the lock and Release lamps.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Williams L-1 and operator adjustment AD33 before planning locks.
Test upper-orbit feeds, upper-flipper staging, right VUK, Release target, and kickback.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: The player used T-O-M-C-A-T to qualify the installed lock sequence, started four-ball Multiball, and completed the three rising Jackpot collects before rebuilding the same cycle.

strategy.simpleOverview: F-14 Tomcat uses the upper orbit and T-O-M-C-A-T targets to qualify locks under the installed setting. Follow the lock and Release lamps, start Multiball, then shoot the right VUK three times for two Landings and the Fighter Jackpot.
strategy.overview: In F-14 Tomcat, complete T-O-M-C-A-T as adjustment AD33 requires, lock each lit ball at the right VUK, and shoot the lit Release shot after the third lock to start four-ball Multiball. Use the upper orbit and staged flippers for letters, follow the displayed lock sequence, then shoot the right VUK twice for Landings and a third time for the Fighter Jackpot.
machineSetup: Confirm Williams L-1 and operator adjustment AD33 before planning locks.
Test upper-orbit feeds, upper-flipper staging, right VUK, Release target, and kickback.
